categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners, property addresses, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
